final_state.objective: Complete the current stage without dying.
final_state.observation_limits: Only currently visible tile geometry and actor positions. Unseen space, hidden enemies, spawn rules and internal timers are unknown.

landing_timing.assumption: Heuristic timing margin; landing near application may occur after A is pressed, so holding A does not establish a new jump.

continuation_search.assumption: Conditional sequences; only the first action is eligible for execution. Replan from real observations. No emulator trials or learned future labels.
